snippet.title: Greenhearth Necromancer | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Greenhearth Necromancer now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2127570/Greenhearth_Necromancer/ 

Raise a garden — from the dead! Greenhearth Necromancer is a cozy, witchy, semi-idle game about caring for a balcony garden — living and undead plants alike! 

🌱 Grow & care for living and undead plants!
🔮 Cast spells, conduct rituals, & brew potions!
💌 Grow your relationship with your neighbours!
📻 Enjoy tunes while you work!

#farmingsimulator #cozygaming #wholesomegames #indiegames #lofichill #idlegame
